tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Announcement of the Count of Years since the Destruction of the (First) Temple, from the Yemenite Baladi-Rite (Tikhlal Ets Ḥayyim of Yiḥya Tsalaḥ)

tei:div.tei:head: Announcement of the Count of Years since the Destruction of the (First) Temple, from the Yemenite Baladi-Rite (Tikhlal Ets Ḥayyim of Yiḥya Tsalaḥ)

tei:lg.tei:l: For our iniquities and our ancestors’ iniquities,
We count from the destruction of the house of our God,
And the scattering of this people of the CAUSE from our holy land.
Today, from the destruction of the Second House
And from the destruction of the First House
and the scattering of our exile’s people
we exiled here in these lands [Yemen] count:
For this, we lie down in shame and our disgrace covers us
And we will not forget our beautiful Holy Place, if our right hand forgets. (Jeremiah 3:25)
For this we will weep and lament all the days of our years
And will not take comfort until our glorious House is built
And God returns us to the border of our lands.

tei:note.tei:p: This calculation is for the year 5781/2021 according to traditional rabbinic Jewish reckoning which holds that the destruction of the second temple occurred in 68CE (rather than 70 CE). To calculate, take the current Jewish year and subtract 3828.

This calculation is for the year 5781/2021 according to traditional rabbinic Jewish reckoning which holds that the destruction of the first temple occurred in 423 BCE (rather than 587 BCE). To calculate, take the current Jewish year and subtract 3338.
